A wonderful, secure, and beautiful environment for all kinds of activities for members of all demographics, from tennis and swimming to just walking the grounds. The atmosphere is fantastic for families.
Would recommend!
The perfect club right in the heart of downtown Cairo! Every sport you can imagine, restaurants, pools, spa, and lots and lots of green!

One of the unique social and sporting clubs in Cairo!

It is spacious with many playgrounds all around, also restaurants and many café places.

You can enjoy outing there with family and friends for having great time in a classy environment.

#I've been there & it's worth visiting

By: Rafi

The Club is relatively quiet in the morning. There are plenty of tables and chairs to choose from. Arrive early on Friday before prayers to secure a parking spot inside the club. Good and drink services are plenty. The Lido pool was looking great and many young adults and older swimmers were enjoying the pool.

Great sporting club with plenty of greenery and quiet, and which has something to offer for all ages.
The kids area has many playgrounds, which are suitable for kids of various ages, and also has shaded spots. The play structures seemed to be in good condition.
The pools were clean enough, although the locker rooms could benefit from some renovating. There are also shallow pools for smaller kids, who can't yet swim.
All in all, a lovely place to spend your leisure time.

Sending a morning in nature with beautiful pigeons singing and dancing is like being enveloped in a symphony of tranquility and grace.

The gentle rustle of leaves, the crisp morning air, and the melodic coos of the pigeons create a harmonious ambiance that soothes the soul.

Observing these graceful birds as they gracefully move and express themselves through dance is a reminder of the beauty and elegance that exists in the natural world.

It's a serene experience that fills the heart with joy and gratitude, a perfect way to start the day on a peaceful note.
Only green and spacious area in the middle of town

One of the few very well preserved places left in Cairo almost untouched since the 50s. A sporting club that offers a wide range of facilities for almost every and all sports. Some of the best clay tennis courts, and one of the most renowned gold courses in the heart of Cairo. Some of the trees there go way back in time and have been planted there since the 50s. It also offers many social areas with convenient outlets with very affordable prices. A true gem lying on the island of Zamalek in the heart of Cairo.

One of the best and oldest clubs in Egypt. A lot of greenery and sitting area. They have several pools, tennis courts, squash courts, croquet, gyms and spaces for martial arts and yoga. It's only members club. There's several restaurants and coffee shops here as well.

If u want to enjoy open air with affordable prices for everything but unfortunately it is for members only. U can eat and drink and enjoy fresh air with reasonable prices. I love to eat in the elite restaurant specially on Sunday for Molakhia.

Iconic, historic and full of life. Classy club on the beautiful island of Zamalek. Horse riding, golf, football, tennis, squash, basketball are just a few of the sports you can do here. Two gyms, an Olympic size swimming pool, a state of the art gymnastics hall built in the last 3 years. Best part about the club is the members. Well kept, elegant people from around Cairo frequent the Gezira Club. HSBC office available, too as well as a variety of food options. God bless GSC. A historic marvel.

Guezira Sporting Club is an absolute gem and a cornerstone of my life. From the moment you step through its gates, you’re greeted with an atmosphere brimming with nostalgia and warmth. This club isn’t just a place to work out; it’s a community, a sanctuary, and a second home.

The facilities are top-notch, catering to a wide range of sports and recreational activities. Whether you’re into tennis, swimming, or just enjoying a leisurely stroll through the beautiful, well-maintained gardens, Guezira has something for everyone. The staff are always friendly and attentive, making every visit a pleasant experience.

What truly sets Guezira Sporting Club apart, though, is its deep-rooted history and the sense of belonging it fosters. Many of us have grown up here, forging lifelong friendships and creating countless memories. The club’s rich heritage is felt in every corner, from the historic architecture to the vibrant community events that bring members together.

For anyone looking to be part of a place where tradition meets modernity, and where every visit feels like coming home, Guezira Sporting Club is simply unparalleled. It’s not just a sports club; it’s a treasure trove of cherished moments and a hub of enduring connections. Highly recommended!

This club sits on a large real estate in downtown Zamalek. It is the oldest sporting clubs in Cairo and have many programs to make it appealing. It has a 9 hole golf course with an interesting 18 hole setup. (9 holes but 18 fairways). Beautiful horse stables sporting it's old British colonial heritage. Plenty clay tennis courts, football (soccer) fields, basketball courts, swimming pools, gym, croquet fields, running tracks, volleyball courts etc. Needless to say it is a wonderful facility.

The reason for not giving 5 stars is as follows:
1.  Expensive, which would be acceptable as foreigners, however there is none around to make this happen.
2.  No corporate office to dazzle with a marketing pitch or attempts to sell membership.
3.  It feels like trying to enter Fort Knox, a lot of security (OK), but with such international clientele not many English speakers at the gates.
4.  One off ticket is 150 EGP, which can be purchased at one gate only #1 even though there are many entrances along the fence line.
5.  Lot of repairs and construction going on around the property.
Percect for spending the day outdoors.   You need to be a member though.  For club members, prices are very reasonable for all services, activities, drinks and even restaurants inside the club.

Gezira Sporting Club is a truly iconic institution in Cairo, known for its rich history, beautiful grounds, and diverse range of activities.

It's a special place that has been cherished by generations of families.

I have enjoyed my childhood in every corner in it. And my children are enjoying it too.
A place to chill out ,it was like a paradise but unfortunately it doesn't have variety of restaurants in the food court

Best sporting club in Egypt. Lots of green area, all sport facilities available, Olympic pool. Several coffee shops, fresh juice stand. It has an oriental restaurant “my Corner’ serving breakfast foul and ta3mia. Also has a grilled chicken restaurant. Very convenient the HSBC BANK  and the post office. It also has a pharmacy, Baraka for eyewear and inter sport for buying sports equipment

Many sports to choose from with qualified trainers and there is terrific resaurants with delicious food as well beside the social life it is amazing , ths cafe is agnificent with their famous ice blended and capiccino and there is Mcdonald restaurant too

In my visit to Egypt, usually I visit touristy area with a phenomenal experience and wonderful service. This is the first time I explored Egypt outside of tourist area and this place was definitely a disappointment. The pictures are nothing like reality. The chairs are falling apart and have bird poop all over them. Server are the rudest I have seen in Egypt very unusual. It could be very likely due to the environment that surrounds them which the attendees of the location.
Most prestigious sport club in Egypt. Membership required
One of the best sporting clubs in Egypt, administration should take care of the maintenance

One of the best places in the country, as it resembles both part of Egypts history and the the exclusive ness of the members, and their families, all of the embassies have annual membership here, also Barrack Obama was here, the Egyptian King is a member of this club, that tells a lot about how this club should be the best, i am member since birth, so i will start by my earliest memory, which was Horseback riding, they have very good trainers to teach you the beginner skills in horse back riding till you reach an advanced level, also there is a lot of kids activities and areas, and exclusive areas for the adults both air conditioned and out side, the whole club is wheel chair accessible, the dinner never fail to let me down but the recent times the food is not as diverse as it used to be and the cheif is not as good as the previous ones, but the previous one was a one of the best in Egypt so its an un fair comparison, but overall the best time can be spent there.
Well organised... security strictly followed,.. kiosk,  restaurant, coffee shop... clean and staff are helpful.
Very nice club with decent people  👍👍👍
Cozy, open air retreat especially for athletes and elders....😄

Would not recommend getting a membership as a foreigner. It’s very expensive and most of the activities (including the gym) cost extra. The club must have been nice once a
upon a time, but it is very run down. Nowhere near the worth the price of entry. The security staff can also be very rude. Not the treatment you would expect as a member of a prestigious club.
Sure it’s a good place
Wonderful place i love it so much❤️❤️
Best club in Egypt….. very helpful staff very nice members
The food was wonderful and the atmosphere very nice, the only issue was the cats didn’t have any boundaries.
Relaxing place, good environment, very nice people. A good place to enjoy a Sunday
Very nice gardens and facilities. Nice people

Nostalgic place with great childhood memories, clean, friendly staff, organized, a new restaurant has opened there I would like to try it I don't recall it's name but it's at the Lido in the upper floor and they say they have great Napolitano pizza

The main office workers are terrible,  so rude and unkind. I don't know why they work there. They don't want to give me the details. I've ever never seen this kind of terrible lady in my life. She   was sitting on the corner, and she spoke with frown eyes.
The headquarters team should train the office workers how to reply to the first visitors.

It's a private club . Only members can go in. With the option of , the probability of inviting guests against fees. It's a social & sport's club. Big area. Having multiple areas to have a drink or dine. Swimming pools and other sport's playgrounds are available. You have to be a member to enter or any member have the right to invite a friend against fees.
Gezira club celebrated new year 2021
Nice social club and beautiful landscapes variety of sports and food .. good place for pets
The best club in egypt 🇪🇬
One of the nicest clubs in Cairo with great sport facilities and food areas

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Gezira Sporting Club, and I was truly impressed by the club's rich history and luxurious amenities. Founded in 1882, the club has a grand and prestigious heritage that is evident in every aspect of its facilities. The club boasts of lush gardens, well-maintained swimming pools, and exceptional sporting activities like tennis and squash, all in excellent condition and well-equipped. The staff at the club is professional, friendly, and always ready to help, making my visit all the more enjoyable. The high-class and luxurious service provided by the club is truly unmatched, and it is the perfect place for anyone looking to relax, unwind, and escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. I highly recommend Gezira Sporting Club to anyone looking for a place to experience luxury and history while enjoying some quality time with loved ones

One of the best places in Cairo / Egypt for chilling, sporting, golf, swimming but definitely it requires tickets with a member or seasonal membership for non-Egyptians, but you will have a great place 2nd to your home to chill out and relax, no need to add photos i guess since others have better photography skills than i am 😅

Had dinner with a friend in the upper restaurant in the new building. The AC was weak - we had to request that the dirty table cloth be replaced - the employees were  not all wearing uniforms - many children were present (we were told it is because the ground floor restaurant was in maintenance) - we ordered scallop but were told it was not available and settled for a filet.
We later went down to the tea garden and ordered lemon juice but were told it is unavailable!
What happened to our historic club?
Beautiful facilities, great food, relaxing atmosphere, and fat cats everywhere (love to see well-fed animals in Cairo!)
The club offers various facilities for their members and also allow guests to enjoy some. Make sure you respect the club rules & community compliances.

A wonderful place, there are many plants and greenery inside, a real park atmosphere.  the games are very modern, an experience for children.  there are many sports opportunities.  clean, beautiful environment.  with a well-located canteen.  a real complex.

An oasis in the middle of Cairo. Facilities for practically every sport including a nine-hole golf course and two swimming pools, croquet, tennis, squash and gymnastics to name a few. Several restaurants and cafes with prices far below similar establishments outside the club.  . Membership in this historic place makes life in Cairo much more pleasant.
This club is so fun the babygarden us so fun and you can eat McDonald's or have a cold drink 5 stars for this club

You need to be with a member to enter as a guest. I went on a Thursday, entry was 160 EGP
This place simply feels like home, wide selection of food, big open spaces to walk or even sit with your laptop and work! Not my first time there and definitely not the last
So green place with pools and restaurants and  small coffee shops

Excellent space,  service and greenery.
New garden for dog owners to gather with their dogs together.
Club staff are very cooperative and do their best to make your wishes come true.
Staff not greedy like new sports club in New settlements in New Cairo.
There you can feel and live family life again and again ❤
Very well established, and members are very pleasant. There are different restaurants offering a variety of food for reasonable prices. Pets are allowed and have a special area to wonder about.
The best club in Egypt.
Good place for kids to learn and play
Nice place Nice members
A breath of fresh air from the suffocating concrete jungle
It's very good and has everything u can imagine, especially restaurants

one of Egypt's oldest and nicest clubs. many trees and seating areas They have a number of swimming pools, tennis facilities, squash courts, croquet courts, gyms, and areas for yoga and martial arts. It is a private club. Additionally, there are numerous eateries and coffee shops in this area.

The only problem was that the cats had no boundaries, despite the excellent cuisine and lovely atmosphere.
My little piece of paradise😘

Very biased rating the club could easily be a lot better and cleaner with more diversity regarding services offered in the club but to standards in Cairo generally I give it a thumbs up and at least there is constant renovation but needs more innovation. That being said its the best in Egypt again I remind you that I'm definitely not objective
My second home! ❤️ Literally the last best place in Cairo.

Still holding strong as the vintage sporting club of Cairo.  Premises kept to their best,  breathing their glorious historical past. Patrons are unchanged despite the years.  Sports facilities are improving. Pools are kept rigorously and impeccably clean.  Green areas are plenty but could do with an extra effort for more green lawns.  The eternal crows are all over the place,  ready to snatch your meal.
Serenity is everything here!

My club or more like my second home where people spend their best times in this place. It's only accessible for those who has membership in the place. You can do everything related to sports has a nice new gym, 2 big pools, 2 running tracks that includes football. Simply amazing.

Run down. Need a lot of attention from board members. Food 3 f
Stars. Good service

Beautiful facilities. Can play tennis and golf and a few other sports

Unfortunately, no one really speaks English that works there.
Entrance is 160 LE.

We played golf and were told we need a caddy. He ended up charging 300LE for 18 holes.

A nice place for a morning jogging. However, the CONDITION of the playground is HORRIBLE, far away from all safety regulations. The fees paid for membership or single entries are high enough to REQUIRE PERFECT SERVICE of all the attractions. The management should take a closer look at the kids' area as soon as possible since lots of people come with their children.

Your timeless outdoor living room,
Absolutely no other place compared

You know what would be amazing? All the members of this private club can get together and turn the golf course into a beautiful central public park for the people of Cairo, similar to Central Park or even better. So much potential. What a lasting legacy for the members.
The club restaurant is very good with excellent service. I totally recommend the food there. Otherwise, the club doesn't offer much sport activities for adults..
Except for parking, it's always a pleasure to visit and have a meal there.

Nice place to rest in the middle of a crowded city. And if you are an expat in Egypt having your family with you, it seems the only place in which you can let your kids run around without being afraid to get hit by a car. A lot of playgrounds and possibilities to do sports. The membership is a bit expensive but a must have for our family.
It's getting a bit annoying that they always give the place around the playground for rental for birthdays and therefore chairs and tables missing for the regular members.
Best Club ever in Cairo. Great Atmosphäre great food best Service

Best club in Egypt, still elegant, members are elegant and sofisticated. Greenery everywhere, flowers bloom. One of the best golf course, tennis courts and gym. Beautiful swimming pools. All us great and you feel at ease. My only concern is they need to decrease the amount of shops rented selling food. Very prohibited to be surrounded by food all the time.
Nice place to hang out
One of the best clubs in Egypt

One of the oldest clubs in Egypt land is great but people changed hope to see what I used to see in the 70's and 80's ...respect...caring...love and loyalty to the place to keep it clean also choosing who is giving the service and how they talk how they dress they are the front mirror of the club. God bless you all.

The new management is great! The Golf course is beautiful and original , the new 400 meter track is soft on the knees and the large track is a bliss in nature . It’s an affordable club for all and much appreciated
Amazing Club to do sports, swim, chill and eat.

Gezira Club is a private club where only members are allowed to enter for free and visitors need a ticket.
Visitors are allowed in all parks, restaurants, fields, except for the swimming pool. Visitors are not allowed to use the swimming pool.
The club has a kids playground, tennis courts, football pitches, basketball courts, swimming pools, gyms, restaurants and coffee shops.
It’s the best place if you live close to Zamalek and worth every penny for the membership.
It is a beautiful green space amid a buzzing cement city. however, lacks basic functional upkeeping, cleanliness, and amenities.

Amazing place, great childhood memories, clean, friendly staff, great place to hang out with family and friends, variety of food is available to choose from whether u choose l'aroma, McDonald's, peking or the club's restaurant food. Their portions are big and it is enough to fulfill your appetite. My favorite dish is escalope maison with fries and vegetables. I also love their breakfast at My Corner. I usually order fool eskandarany, taameya and omlete with cheese. My favorite drink is lemon mint, it is so fresh and tasty. Coffee lab and House of Coffee Mood Provacateur are great for delicious coffee. Move gym also has fresh smoothies and protein shakes. For me, the club has recently been a good place to study for exams and finish my assignments and to have a good walk. I rate gezira club 5 out of 5.
Lots of beautiful fields available, the track is also very high quality - mostly visible markers every 100m. The public restroom is not nice, which is why this is 4 of 5 stars

Location 5 stars it’s a very nice place but it’s very dirty and they don’t clean the showers or bathrooms after 4 days that I have been there I saw the same garbage and chewing gums and left over empty shampoo bottles that no one ever puts in the trash. I just stopped going because how nothing is clean. In Canada when you pay that much to go in a place it is cleaned everyday and you don’t need to pay for towels to take a showers. This place makes you pay for borrowing a towel to shower up.lol  Also never order a salade from the main resto’s it’s soaked in a big quantity of yellow mustard and they say it’s dressing which is very bitter and you can’t taste the salade anymore. The location is very impressing it’s the most prestigious sporting club in Egypt but bathrooms and showers are disgusting.
Greatest Sporting club

It's very good as a club to join considering the price of membership. Crowded cause of the low subscription. Have a 20L.E ticket to enter if you are not a member . The place is very wide and open. Doesn't have lots of closed area as a cafe or dinning place.

Upscale social club. Extremely crowded on weekend with families with Noticeably high age bracket and very limited parking spaces.
Weekdays are great where you can enjoy the various different facilities with ease.

Extremely Elegant place... lot of green areas... a place where u can play any kind of sport, surrounded by nice people... as well as a great variety of restaurants and food ... walking areas... also a place to walk your dog... and a beautiful gym.. summary u can find everything..
One of the best social/sporting clubs in Egypt. Entry is for members only. The pictures i am adding shows the "large" and increasing community of crows.

Visited Egypt for a couple weeks and happened upon this place by chance. Walking across bridge/Nile River in Cairo and saw a colorful playground from a distance. Since I have a five year old, it was a we have to visit this playground type of thing. It is a private club where you have to pay an entry fee and go through security. They don't allow picture taking and wanted me to give up my camera. Luckily, one of the security guards suggested handing over my camera battery, which I was much happier to do since that can be replaced easily and fairly cheaply compared to my DSLR! The playground has multiple playsets inside and is very nice and varied. I will give it that. We seemed to be the only foreigners in the complex. The children were very friendly and seemed to also be very curious about us. Though, many wanted to play with my daughter and did. Loved the playgrounds. Had a food bar with good and cheap food. Service was good for the food area. Plentiful and lovely seating areas around playground and large, covered one for food bar. Decent bathrooms. Nice enough and definitely upscale looking place for Egypt. However, did not love paying admission for what I would essentially classify as a park. I believe parks and pen air spaces throughout the world should be free, but all governments/countries run differently and when in Egypt we must do as the Egyptians do! From my memory, I remember the admission was not a lot, but I did see Egyptians that went in and looked like they did not pay. Maybe there are memberships? Anyway, not sure I would go again, but was an okay spot for us to do a child-focused activity for my daughter while traveling and she very much enjoyed it. ;  )
Good club for athletes
We only used the play area for our toddler and it was great and we met lots of other like minded families there , well worth the visit

It's a very good club but, it's important to know that the membership is expensive  for now it's about 50,000 egp or 3,097.86 United States dollar of cource you don't have to pay yearly you can pay Installment i know it's a little bit expensive but In my opinion i think it's worth it I mean i used to play basketball there and it's very good i highly recommend this club

I have been a member for 20 years I must point I love this club but I have some comments on it like wifi isn’t covered in the whole club add to that parking in the weekend is a nightmare and they need to open the cinema again and finish the swimming pool construction besides that I am satisfied

I love this club as it is located on the island called Aljazeera which is surrounded by the mighty Nile River. You can enjoy the fresh air and beautiful trees and plants. I took these nice pictures while walking on the 6th October Bridge. You might need to pay ticket to get in.

Wonderful place to spend your time. They have amazing facillities; pools, showers, gyms, play area, fast food and restaraunts, hair salon, horse riding, football, basketball, gymnastics and so much more!

One of the most prestigious clubs in Egypt. Built in the 1900's .  Lively place with lots of greenery.
Enterance is for members only.

The club is very enjoyable, a good get away from Cairo's daily routine.

Here you'd find many sports activities (horse riding!), restaurants, cafes.

I like the additional tax free benefits on purchases even in their pharmacy.

The warm out door pool is not to be missed at night, especially with a hot drink.

Food is just OK, service is slow, most of the chairs need to be replaced.
Chairs are in a better state than before. Service is relatively fast when number of members is not high.

Sports club like no other,  mixing classic and modern styles, sprawling over a huge area and sticking to the rules of a 'private' club.  Clean premises, lush green areas,  golf course on par with international standards.  However,  the eternal problems are still there...  F&B doubtful oftentimes,  shower 🚿 stall hygiene doubtful,  changing rooms need refurbishing,  watchdog control staff unpleasant and stiff,  parking lot packed almost always,  poor website,  no tech fun for leisure time.  Still the best though...

A heaven for people with children living on Zamalek island! Playgrounds are big and well-equipped and maintained. That said, there's a lot of room for improvement. Although there are different foods offered, the choice of healthy food for kids is lacking. Another issue is the complete lack of transparency for membership for Non-Egyptians; they neither provide clear info nor update the website with rules.

It's a rundown sports club with odious security guards who would harass its clients quite badly by yelling at you in an incredibly uncivilised manner not to let you in despite the entitlement. Please watch out! Uncivilised, chaotic, violent, lowly cultured, and open for troubles, not up to the standards for international diplomatic society members.

Very well maintained. All kinds of food available, green space, rooftop restaurant has a good chinese menu. Equestrians will love their stables. All kinds of other sports of course. Many social areas. Tea garden is quite neat, and their salon is chic and quiet if you need to work. You'll enjoy the architecture of some of the buildings, this is a classic historical club. Not much parking. No wifi where I've been. If you're not a member of the club, just a bring a friend who is and you buy a ticket for 75 LE on weekdays, it goes higher on weekends and of course if you're reading this a year in the future ;) .

It is the best sporting as well as as social club in Cairo. You find a lot of restaurants if you to have lunch or dinner. You can the chance to do different types of sports. Enjoy the landscape there.

My club been there since I was a kid and I love it, is it a perfect place no can it be improved yes in so many ways, however if u decided to spend a day there you will defenatly not regret it wether you want to play sports , chill , swim or even have a meal it's definitely a good place.

One of the biggest sports club in Egypt ... it has a bit of a royal history amd still preserve its class ... For visitors though it's not allowed to be in any of the pools . Ticket prices are around 60 for Egyptians and 90 for foreigners for entry . One of the beautiful places is the golf court area , you can rent all golf equipments and enjoy a peaceful game
Best club in Cairo! Good food at reasonable prices, a lot of entertainment activities available , professional staff and the best of all , everything is TAX free. Membership is for foreigners only.
After they cleaned it up its like a whole new club... It Has everything you could possibly want in a sporting club.. I love going there every time I get a chance to
Only open space accessible. Food and drinks supplied with disposables by masked waiters. Social distancing observed. Some renovation work still incomplete in one track.

A sportive and social place belongs to the government under administration of Sport and Youth Ministry.

If you haven't a membership then you should pay a ticket for entering.

The current price for a ticket is EGP 20 to all week days, except to Friday,  Saturday plus any public holiday -- it going to be  EGP 25 for a ticket.

You will enjoy with practice sport and nice views as well as the very long run-track if you like to run and walk or even to stroll.

This is a beautiful environment but grossly mismanaged.  The restaurants are about average in terms of quality and taste. Competition is almost nonexistent as far as higher end restaurants.
There is the monopoly on offering juices by the FBI who has been therefor more than 10 years.  The place doubles the prices every few months with rude servers.  They charge you LE 20 for a carrot juice that you can get in any Zamalek juice shop for about LE 6. I am not sure why this club offers worse choices than other comparable clubs in greater Cairo. I hope its management can move toward raising the quality, service and value of food and drinks.
I like it but it change a lot . It use to be the best club in Cairo but the level whent much down . Actualy i visit every year this year is little bet better than 3 , 2 years ago.
A Beautiful place for both activities and relaxation

It is known for it's elite and high standard members, whereby the community is relatively close and tight. It has many open spaces where members sit, eat, have juice, enjoy a conversation in a relaxing atmosphere, while in the shade. It features most sports, including ballet, gymnastics, horseback riding, golf, tennis, squash, swimming, diving, synchronised swimming, waterpolo, karate, judo, basketball, handball, volleyball, football, and others. It has running tracks, restaurants with different cuisines. New membership will cost u a fortune.
Parking available inside, large area with different sports to train many places to rest and enjoy poeple are mostly respectfull especially old ones
Kids playground needs repairs, kids area needs to be more safe and also members have right for open playgrounds what's the benefit of being member and have a card if I can't use my membership

I sincerely do not recommend this place as a foreigner, reasons

1) rude and do not speak English , treat you as trash

2) guy wants a huge entrance fee 150 egp per person beyond reasoning, even if you just want to eat food ?

3) the security was biased

Heated pool during the sunset? Yes please.

Pleasure to have breakfast at mycorner in the morning, and lovely walk around the golf course.

A lovely club in the middle of zamalek, founded 1935 so its historic and the people suuronding you are classy and well educated. Has hot two pool areas and the leedo looks like a pool in a hotel. Prices are very good, with good quality and adequate service. Staff are generally friendly and helpful. A nice place to work, read, eat, play, meet friends, you can also bring your kids. They have good some places covered with wifi and it opened till around 11 at night with good parking areas. Avoid Friday's as it's very crowded.

amazing place to play soccer with friends and co-workers. too bad they dont allow girls to play soccer in thier soccer fields. too bad also now they charge more if you have Foreigners with you . too bad some places in Egypt are still retarded like this
Very exclusive club. Food was excellent at Mocha restaurant.

Greenery & open air areas  are the amazing attraction of one of the oldest clubs in Egypt where only members & their guests are allowed in.
A huge variety of sporting & cultural activities are available. Courts are numerous for every game  including tennis, squash  all ball-sports ..... marshal  art ..... horse back- riding croquet &  even golf
You  can either  play with friends or  practice with trainers.The club offers  many services to GSC  members  including issuing  civil documents, paying bills & buying basic needs.   Beautiful  & spacious kids area. Separate playground for each age group.  Many restaurants & coffee  shops with a wide range in varity, quality & price. A small food court  serves meals , snacks & desserts. They all offer a wide menu of both oriental &  occidental dishes.
Staff & employees all over the club. Usually they try to be helpful & polite.
Public can buy ticket every day except Thursday & Friday

If not the finest and most elie social and sports club in Cairo (and Egypt)  then it's one of the 2 finest (If you're from Heliopolis and a fan of Heliopolis Sporting Club).
Has one of Cairo's vintage golf courses, and also equestrian courts, located amidst the fine residential areas in the heart of Cairo.
This place is for members only. However entrance tickets are available for guests accompanying members.

Everyone is so found of it.. .why? Probably,  for  Cairo is super dirty, ther aren't real parks and kid's playgrounds, or places for workouts like street gyms on teh shores of Bosphorus.. I laughed a lot when I heard how much my husb paid for my membership:))

Extremely bad that charge us money at the front gate to enter the club and when we went to the pool the security came and ask us to leave as this club is only for members and we got shocked that no one tell us and at the front gate we asked about the pool they don't understand English so it was a communication issue as we don't read arbic
But will not go back their for their behavior and will became a member anywhere else
A very special club that offers a place for socialising, plenty of sports activities and decent food

The 150-acre (0.61 km2) grounds of the Gezira Sporting Club were initially carved out of the Khedivial Botanical Gardens, and as a result acacias and gardens decorate the area. After the land had been formally leased to the British military command in 1882, club rules were licensed and the land was divided into several recreational playing grounds. At first, the club was for the exclusive use of the British Army.[citation needed] Membership was restricted to applicants elected by the committee, on the recommendation of two members, although British army officers were automatically enrolled. There were about 750 members.[citation needed] Guests could visit the club whenever accompanied by those members by purchasing Day Passes for LE 50.[citation needed]

In 1906, the club members asked the Egyptian government for ownership, but their request was refused. Instead, they were granted a 60-year lease.[citation needed]

The exclusive character of the club continued until after World War II. In January 1952, the club was nationalized and became a public club. By this point, most members of the Gezira Sporting Club were Egyptians, but the club's members were from society's elite. As a result of nationalization, the ethos and structure of the club were to be altered during the Nasser regime. Half of its eighteen-hole golf course were given over to a youth club built by the Egyptian government on the club premises (making it a nine-hole course).[2] Much of what was deemed as a traditionally aristocratic asset was nationalized.[citation needed]

During Anwar Al Sadat's presidency, a new elevated highway (the 6th October Bridge) was built over the remaining nine-hole golf course and six-furlong racecourse causing the size of the club to further erode.[citation needed]

Despite suffering vandalism, the Gezira Sporting Club still offers most of the sports and games practiced by its founders: golf, tennis, squash, croquet, horse riding and cricket.[citation needed]

As of 2012, membership was estimated to consist of 43,000 families.
